craft_notes: Sthāyin: crown-crossing (dhāraṇā 8). Sanskrit: tayāpūryāśu mūrdhāntaṃ bhaṅktvā bhrūkṣepasetunā...sarvagodgamaḥ → L4 keeps the four-step chain line 1, consequence line 2. Rows: row 2 (thought-free→all-go-forth). Close: forth (motion resumes). Rejected: 'brahma-randhra' gloss — killed: crown kept plain; 'bridge' alone — brow-toss kept (the toss is the action).

lines: By that quick filling, crown-end broken, brow-toss bridge:
thought-free mind made — above all, all go forth.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tayāpūryāśu mūrdhāntaṃ bhaṅktvā bhrūkṣepasetunā | nirvikalpaṃ manaḥ kṛtvā sarvordhve sarvagodgamaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How does the mind go forth? → The brow-bridge crossed with thought-free mind, all go forth above.
c1_essence: Filling to crown, brow-toss bridge: thought-free mind goes forth.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness with piercing resolve)
